summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, presenting consolidated financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year ended March 2026 under US GAAP. The filing is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event. It discloses record net income of ¥362.1bn, ROE of 10.1%, and a dividend of ¥51 per share. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is announced. The document is a standard periodic update for a foreign private issuer.
